verses.original: δὲ Σὺ λάλει ἃ πρέπει ὑγιαινούσῃ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de Sy lalei ha prepei hygiainousē tē didaskalia
verses.literal: But [as for] you speak the things that are consistent with sound - doctrine

verses.original: Πρεσβύτας εἶναι νηφαλίους σεμνούς σώφρονας ὑγιαίνοντας τῇ πίστει τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ὑπομονῇ
verses.transliteration: Presbytas einai nēphalious semnous sōphronas hygiainontas tē pistei tē agapē tē hypomonē
verses.literal: Older [men] are to be temperate dignified self-controlled [and] sound - in faith - love and perseverance

verses.original: πρεσβύτιδας ὡσαύτως ἱεροπρεπεῖς ἐν καταστήματι μὴ διαβόλους μηδὲ δεδουλωμένας πολλῷ οἴνῳ καλοδιδασκάλους
verses.transliteration: presbytidas hōsautōs hieroprepeis en katastēmati mē diabolous mēde dedoulōmenas pollō oinō kalodidaskalous
verses.literal: Older [women] likewise are to be reverent in [their] behavior not slanderers [or] addicted to much wine [but] teachers of good

verses.original: ἵνα σωφρονίζωσιν τὰς νέας εἶναι φιλάνδρους φιλοτέκνους
verses.transliteration: hina sōphronizōsin tas neas einai philandrous philoteknous
verses.literal: In this way they can train the young [women] to love [their] husbands [and] children

verses.original: σώφρονας ἁγνάς οἰκουργούς ἀγαθάς ὑποτασσομένας τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ μὴ βλασφημῆται
verses.transliteration: sōphronas hagnas oikourgous agathas hypotassomenas tois idiois andrasin hina ho logos tou Theou mē blasphēmētai
verses.literal: [to be] self-controlled pure managers of their households kind [and] submissive to [their] own husbands so that the word - of God vvv will not be discredited
In the same way urge the younger [men] to be self-controlled

verses.original: Περὶ πάντα παρεχόμενος σεαυτὸν τύπον καλῶν ἔργων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀφθορίαν σεμνότητα
verses.transliteration: Peri panta parechomenos seauton typon kalōn ergōn en tē didaskalia aphthorian semnotēta
verses.literal: In everything show yourself {to be} an example [by doing] good works In [your] teaching [show] integrity dignity

verses.original: ὑγιῆ λόγον ἀκατάγνωστον ἵνα ὁ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἐντραπῇ ἔχων μηδὲν φαῦλον λέγειν περὶ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: hygiē logon akatagnōston hina ho ex enantias entrapē echōn mēden phaulon legein peri hēmōn
verses.literal: [and] wholesome speech [that is] above reproach so that anyone who opposes [us] will be ashamed having nothing bad to say about us

verses.original: Δούλους ὑποτάσσεσθαι ἰδίοις δεσπόταις ἐν πᾶσιν εἶναι εὐαρέστους μὴ ἀντιλέγοντας
verses.transliteration: Doulous hypotassesthai idiois despotais en pasin einai euarestous mē antilegontas
verses.literal: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything to be well-pleasing not argumentative

verses.original: μὴ νοσφιζομένους ἀλλὰ ἐνδεικνυμένους πᾶσαν ἀγαθήν πίστιν ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν κοσμῶσιν τὴν διδασκαλίαν τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Σωτῆρος
verses.transliteration: mē nosphizomenous alla endeiknymenous pasan agathēn pistin hina en pasin kosmōsin tēn didaskalian tēn tou Theou hēmōn Sōtēros
verses.literal: not stealing [from them] but showing all good faith so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about - God our Savior

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ Ἐπεφάνη σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: gar hē charis tou Theou Epephanē sōtērios pasin anthrōpois
verses.literal: For the grace - of God has appeared bringing salvation to everyone . . .

verses.original: παιδεύουσα ἡμᾶς ἵνα ἀρνησάμενοι τὴν ἀσέβειαν καὶ κοσμικὰς τὰς ἐπιθυμίας ζήσωμεν σωφρόνως καὶ δικαίως καὶ εὐσεβῶς ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι
verses.transliteration: paideuousa hēmas hina arnēsamenoi tēn asebeian kai kosmikas tas epithymias zēsōmen sōphronōs kai dikaiōs kai eusebōs en tō nyn aiōni
verses.literal: It instructs us to renounce - ungodliness and worldly - passions [and] to live sensible - upright and godly [lives] in the present age

verses.original: προσδεχόμενοι τὴν μακαρίαν ἐλπίδα καὶ τῆς δόξης ἐπιφάνειαν τοῦ ἡμῶν μεγάλου Θεοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: prosdechomenoi tēn makarian elpida kai tēs doxēs epiphaneian tou hēmōn megalou Theou kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: as we await the blessed hope and - glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὃς ἔδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα λυτρώσηται ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀνομίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἑαυτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον ζηλωτὴν καλῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: hos edōken heauton hyper hēmōn hina lytrōsētai hēmas apo pasēs anomias kai katharisē heautō laon periousion zēlōtēn kalōn ergōn
verses.literal: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession zealous for good deeds

verses.original: λάλει Ταῦτα καὶ παρακάλει καὶ ἔλεγχε μετὰ πάσης ἐπιταγῆς μηδείς περιφρονείτω σου
verses.transliteration: lalei Tauta kai parakalei kai elenche meta pasēs epitagēs mēdeis periphroneitō sou
verses.literal: Speak these things [as] you encourage and rebuke with all authority {Let} no one despise you
